verdict.rationale: Tailscale's network layer is documented to enable SSH access to remote hosts (auditable SSH access, direct SSH anecdotes), and since scp/sftp ride over the same SSH protocol, they would be usable over a tailnet with normal keys, but the evidence pack never explicitly mentions scp/sftp or file-transfer key configuration; community evidence even flags real performance drag on file transfers over Tailscale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scp/sftp support, confirmation that configured SSH keys work unmodified for file transfer, and no independent corroboration of scp/sftp specifically (only general SSH and file-transfer performance complaints).
